title: Bound and initialize all three exact general-LP certificate searches in the allowed model
statement: Compute integerized C=QA,h=Qb,g=Qc by prefix/suffix denominator products and R=2L!U^L. Bound every nonnegative variable by R in exactly one feasible status system: optimal Cx=h,C^T(yplus-yminus)+s=g,g^T x-h^T(yplus-yminus)=0; infeasible C^T(fplus-fminus)-s=0,h^T(fplus-fminus)=-1; unbounded Cx=h,Cv=0,g^T v=-1. Output primal/dual optimum, original Farkas b^Tf=-1/Q<0, or BOTH feasible point and improving ray c^Tv=-1/Q<0. For Dz=f,0<=z<=R, bounded phase-I adds aplus,aminus with known strictly positive start z=R/2,a±=max(±(f-Dz),0)+1 and explicit complement slacks below K0=2(1+sum|f|+Rsum|D|). Minimum sum(a++a-)=0 iff original system feasible.

U^L costs O(K+L) allowed operations/comparisons and O(L[B+log(K+1)+log L]) encoding bits. Three bounded standard-form certificate systems and explicit bounded phase-I have dimension O(m+n), polynomial formation and BIT sizes. These cheap transformations do not find the unknown zero-cost face. Circuit/support-selector reductions use at most three calls to an UNCONSTRUCTED strongly polynomial primitive.
